node_patches.append_notes: Taiwan-based epi-wafer specialist; competes with Visual Photonics Epitaxy (VPEC) and LandMark Optoelectronics. Critical supplier for InP epi-wafer (optical chiplet) demand surge 2026+; US Chips Act funding signals geopolitical importance. Not a bottleneck for HBM CoWoS but upstream critical for optical interconnect specialty devices (transceiver chiplets, co-packaged optics). Visibility to 2027-2028 suggests capacity risk if datacenter optical demand maintains trajectory.
